svg.title: autoware.launch.xml includes component_control.launch.xml, which includes control.launch.xml of autoware_control_launch. control.launch.xml reads a module preset of autoware_control_config. In the control namespace it includes the trajectory follower, the command gate, the external command, and the control checker launch files, and the control evaluator.
svg.text: Composable node, for the default mode
Launch files of their autoware_ packages
Containers: control_container and control_check_container. The parameter files are in autoware_control_config.
Default values come from default_preset.yaml: the gray boxes are off by default.
